create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData graph object from an ASE Atoms object with neighbor cutoff and max neighbors
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert an AtomicData object back to an ASE Atoms object with energy, forces, and stress
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into one batched AtomicData object for model inference
extract_example_from_batch: extract a single AtomicData example from a batched AtomicData object by index
update_batch_edges: update the edge connectivity of a batched AtomicData object with new edge index and cell offsets
